tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search a brand storefront catalog. Returns structured products with price, availability, variants, PDP URLs, and the checkout contract.

tools.name: get_product_feed
tools.description: Get the machine-readable product feed URL (OpenAI/ACP product feed JSON) and llms.txt discovery file for a brand.

tools.name: get_policies
tools.description: Get shipping, delivery, returns, refund, privacy, and terms policy page URLs for a brand storefront.

tools.name: create_cart
tools.description: Create an agent cart session. Returns a cart_token for subsequent mutations and quotes.

buyer_email.description: Buyer email carried into the cart session for checkout

tools.name: mutate_cart
tools.description: Add, set, or clear items on an existing cart session.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Read a cart session by cart_token.

tools.name: quote_cart
tools.description: Quote a cart session — totals, shipping, tax before checkout.

tools.name: confirm_checkout
tools.description: Confirm checkout for a quoted cart. Creates an order when the quote matches.

buyer_email.description: Required buyer email unless already set on the cart
